issues.reason: The whenever machinery mandates "the response as a Skolem event per occurrence, tied to its trigger with During" and indexes it on the trigger variable ((sk_bark $x) over the ring event $x), and the multi-quantifier rule makes a dependent existential "a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it" — (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) omits the trigger event $e, so one consequent event can be During two distinct qualifying station-inheritances, which no single event can truly be.

defect_summary: The compliant form indexes the consequent event on the trigger occurrence — (sk_inherit_notebook $e) (or (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k $e), a function of every scoping universal) with (During (sk_inherit_notebook $e) $e) — everything else in the rule unchanged.
notes: The rest is clean: lantern_station/notebook genus atoms with the noun modifiers correctly unexposed, Theme for inherit, Possession possessed-first for both genitives, no QuantifierPhrase (whenever is a frequency conditional), and (sk_notebook $k) rightly covaries with the Keeper alone.
